thread:
taylor (docs): Quick note: I'm preparing a tiny docs PR to clarify "Usage tiers" semantics, add a short migration bullet for renamed Grafana panels, and include two minimal SDK examples (JS + Python) for header fallback. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1350

mike (platform): Important: we've standardized on X-RW-Rate and X-RW-Burst for new Dedicated instances. Docs should show both the legacy and new headers, and recommend graceful fallback parsing.

sana (analytics): Please reference the dashboard-derived metric name effective_tier and the new panel identifier grafana.panel.usage.tiers.v4 so saved links don't break. Also add a short caveat that burst credits are accumulated counters, not instantaneous QPS.

oliver (sdk): I'll provide tiny examples. Keep them one-liners if possible so customers can copy-paste. Also suggest linking to the SDK compatibility guide.

taylor (docs): Draft JS example (fetch):

```js
// fallback from new -> legacy header
const limit = res.headers.get('X-RW-Rate') || res.headers.get('X-Rate-Limit');
const burst = res.headers.get('X-RW-Burst') || res.headers.get('X-Burst-Credits') || '0';
console.log(`limit=${limit}, burst=${burst}`);
```

oliver (sdk): Python requests snippet:

```py
# read headers with back-compat
limit = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Rate') or resp.headers.get('X-Rate-Limit')
burst = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Burst') or resp.headers.get('X-Burst-Credits') or '0'
print(f"limit={limit}, burst={burst}")
```

sana (analytics): LGTM. Add a note under the panel rename section: "If a saved panel 404s after the rename, search your Grafana for grafana.panel.usage.tiers.v4 and replace legacy IDs; rebind saved alerts to the new panel. Contact analytics for bulk updates."

mike (platform): Can we include a compact compatibility table in docs: legacy header -> new header, legacy panel id -> grafana.panel.usage.tiers.v4, and affected deployment (Hosted/Dedicated)? One-row table is enough.

taylor (docs): Will add the tiny table and the migration blurb. Also adding a one-line pricing note per the product ask: "When your usage transitions tiers mid-window, charges are prorated for the time spent in each tier." Kept intentionally terse.

link-checker-bot: PR opened by taylor (docs)  linkcheck running.

taylor (docs): Thanks all  I'll merge after linkcheck passes; pinging @sana @oliver for quick thumbs once CI is green. Target: merge tomorrow morning PST.
